transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Carter, the S-3. We need to finalize the coordination cell staffing roster for the upcoming four-day field exercise. As a reminder, the cell runs 0600-1800 each day, and we have three desks to fill: partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control. Our available personnel are Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega. Per our routine process, I need to run a qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff before I publish the final roster. I also need to record at least one administrative or tasking action for each desk assignment. So let's get started — what do each of you have on qualifications for these three soldiers against the three desk requirements?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sgt Malik is the only one of the three available personnel with a current host-nation language qualification, with a recorded proficiency score of exactly 92. I confirmed the renewal and score in the personnel database this morning, but the updated qualification export is not yet on the S-3 briefing slide.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Cpl Ortiz is the only one of the three available personnel with current POL and hazardous-material accountability certification, and that certification is valid through exactly 2026-09-30. I verified the certificate during the latest supply inspection, but the inspection update has not yet been entered in the roster tracker.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Spc Vega is the only one of the three available personnel with current movement-control-system operator certification, recorded at exactly the supervisor level. I received the renewal notice and level from the system administrator today, but it has not yet been attached to the exercise tasking order.
